entities.name: Ota
entities.description: Flying metallic humanoids without legs or wings, led by praetors, depicted in Lumithread Field.

entities.name: Bastion of Suns
entities.description: Dragons the Ota warred against for control of their world's suns.

entities.name: Lumithread
entities.description: A coiled thread of pure energy the Ota use to feed and protect their outer plating.

events.summary: The Ota fought a war against dragons for control of their world's suns, then gained the power of lumithread.
events.quote: were at war with dragons for the control of their world's suns
